title: Era of Nabonassar
summary: Start of the Babylonian civil era of Nabonassar, the base of Ptolemy's Royal Canon.
description: CFAH-3 anchor point AP-9. Ptolemy's Royal Canon counts Babylonian kings from this era to Alexander. Added by the CFAH pass.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-9: Era of Nabonassar: 747 B.C."
chronologies.note: Berossus's 150,000 days, read as days, triangulate with the Babylonian civil era.
